Required static E2E success fixture:
Use fixed deterministic fake IDs/SHAs/activity/message/answer only.
1) dispatch accepted: begin from a local fixture that explicitly carries one exact 40-lowercase-hex expected target HEAD and a numeric Session ID; assert fixture identities before any mapping. Do NOT claim that this test validates real dispatch transport.
2) IN_PROGRESS: call map_jules_session_state_to_observed_signal("IN_PROGRESS") and assert IN_PROGRESS.
3) NEEDS_INPUT: same exact Session, call state mapper on AWAITING_USER_FEEDBACK and assert NEEDS_INPUT.
4) same-session answer: call decide_same_session_feedback with exact Session, reviewed SMALL_REVERSIBLE_REPO, nonempty agent message, not already answered => CONTROLLER_REVIEW_ELIGIBLE; then call prepare_same_session_message_request with exact matching activity name and assert EXACT legacy payload {session_id, expected_state:"AWAITING_USER_FEEDBACK", prompt:answer}. This remains PREPARED only; assert no send side effect exists in this test.
5) result PR: use one fake exact 40-lowercase-hex result PR head and assert map_result_pr_head_to_observed_state => PR_READY.
6) exact-head checks: map_exact_head_github_run_to_observed_check(result_head, same workflow_head, "completed","success") => PASS.
7) review-ready observed rendering: render_observed_signal_section with COMPLETED, exact result/workflow head and successful workflow, assert SESSION_COMPLETE, PR_READY, PASS, and disclaimer that Observed does NOT prove durable runtime ownership. If renderer wording differs, assert stable semantic tokens already covered by existing renderer tests rather than changing renderer.

Required fail-closed companion cases in same test file:
- different Session at feedback decision => UNKNOWN or preparation rejection;
- activity from different Session => preparation ValueError;
- HUMAN_ONLY => HUMAN_NEEDED and preparation rejection;
- already answered / prior message request exists => NO_ACTION or preparation rejection;
- result PR head differs from workflow head => exact-head CI UNKNOWN;
- malformed result SHA => UNKNOWN;
- unknown Jules state => UNKNOWN.
No raw agent-message leakage in returned prepared request except approved answer prompt. No live request object is persisted.

- clearly document fixture-only boundary and that SF-5 proves static composition, not live delivery/exactly-once/runtime ownership.
